description: Create a new AI character from a plain-text description. Same as `clipugc characters create`. The server extracts the appearance DNA and generates the first look automatically (2 credits; confirm with get_credits). Be specific: nationality, age, hair, eyes, face shape, skin, style, and a realism anchor such as "natural skin texture, not airbrushed". Characters are public by default; set private=true to opt out. make_video=true also stages the first clip (extra clip cost). Returns the character with first_look_id. Looks generate in the background. Poll list_images with the same character id every 5 to 10 seconds until each new look has status "completed" (or "failed"), then pass the look id to create_clip. Advanced: pass name (2-120 chars) plus optional age, gender, dna_json instead of description for a structured create.

description.description: Plain-words description of the person, 10-1000 chars (same as --description). Preferred path.

dna_json.description: [advanced] Appearance DNA fields as an inline JSON object string or a JSON file path (same as --dna-json).

gender.description: [advanced] Gender, e.g. male, female, other (same as --gender).

inspiration.description: Optional local file paths of up to 6 inspiration images (same as --inspiration).

make_video.description: Also stage the character's first video clip (same as --make-video).

motion_prompt.description: Motion prompt for that first clip; requires make_video (same as --motion-prompt).

name.description: [advanced] Full name, 2-120 chars, for the structured path without a description (same as --name).

private.description: Keep the character private (same as --private). Default: public.

scene.description: Optional scene/pose for the first look, up to 600 chars (same as --scene).

name: create_character
title: Create an AI character
